payload.rationale: The reader is comparing hemispheres for an August date, so the invitation sits where that comparison is complete: the primary Concierge link follows the at-a-glance table and frames the decision ('a terrace in Europe against a beach closer to home'). The secondary link closes the practical planning section for the reader ready to turn a shortlist into dates and venues, and the closing section repeats the invitation with the brand-facts reassurances (one Wedded Advisor, start to finish, works in your time zone, quotes in AUD, fee agreed in writing before any work begins), which funding_parent quoted as the line that made them consider clicking. The /magazine link serves the earlier-stage reader (planner_couple, search_visitor) who said they would bookmark and read more before enquiring. All four links are kept exactly as placed, with anchor 'Wedded Concierge' (2 words, no exclamation mark). Panel likelihood to enquire was 2.1: four personas said 'maybe' and uhnw said 'no', each pointing to fee model, commissions, deposits, a private channel, who answers on the day, or real weddings and scale. None of these are confirmed in brand-facts.md, so they are not answered in the post and are passed to /wonderland-concierge as open questions.
